reviews.title: This app takes your money
reviews.text: My wife and I simply wanted to check the app out. It offered a free (3) day trial with no commitment. After the first day, we decided that it wasn’t for us and decided to cancel it. (3) days later, $40 was taken from my account as well as my wife’s. We disputed these transactions twice ending with negative results. If you purchase this app…don’t intend on simply testing it out. You will be charged regardless. 😔

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: I love how no one is talking about how you have to pay a monthly subscription to do this! It’s a lie & a scam!

reviews.title: Needs more to do
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I use this app daily. We need way more to do. More games like tic tac toe or checkers or something. We’re kinda tired of just updating our mood and there isn’t much to interact with after a while simply because the games cost so much and it’s kinda hard to accumulate points for it. We also don’t like how the map doesn’t work or the tv. We feel like there should be an option to put your own song on the radio. Pixels is also not a very good game choice because of how it’s designed.

reviews.title: Cool but
reviews.text: The pixel drawings could be better, there should be be more pixels because there is not nearly enough to draw something as small as a leaf with the humungous squared, please addd 3x3 more, I promise you I only open this game when I have a good amount of time to spend, as well as does my partner, and this section always feels lackluster: everything else is fine though

reviews.title: Paywall for streaks
reviews.text:
If you're neurodivergent, skip this app. Your streak is behind a paywall (no option to use stars/points even), and I lost a 21 day streak originally and now an 85 day streak. 
Every memory is paywall.
Photos? Paywall.
Any musings with each other over 14 days old? Paywall.

It's simply not worth the stress and irritation. The little games can only  be played once a day. 

If you don't want to pay them $40/year, skip the app because you won't get enough features with free. It is pay to play for sure.

reviews.title: You’ll Run Out Of Things To Do Fast
reviews.text: My long distance BF and I loved this app, but that said there is such a lag in between any updates that we quickly went through all of the games and quizzes and decorations, and so I’m canceling my subscription to the app and will probably be deleting it soon

reviews.title: No good options for how I’m feeling
stop ruining ur app
reviews.text: me and my boyfriend have had this app for so long, we had so many notes and pictures, and that was my favorite part of the app. i loved being able to look back on them, now ur making me pay to see all of it?? if that doesn't change im just deleting the app. that was the best part was to look back at our memories and journey. so stupid to do that. i'm actually so upset rn.

reviews.title: Just say you want me to spend money
reviews.text: This game is super cute but almost everything fun/simple is on the premium plan. From decorating your home to game events. I unlocked a game using majority of my star points and I could only do the first level out of eight. Hell you can’t even change from a cat pet that’s default provided to a dog pet without having the premium. It’s a game that’s cute for private back and forth fun with your partner but it is going to get stale pretty damn quick if they don’t add more to the free slots.

reviews.title: Loved This App, But the Paywalls Ruined It.
reviews.text:
My husband and I have used Cozy Couples for years, but at this point, it feels like you guys are just hiding more and more of the app behind a paywall. Photos are hidden, and even certain events are hidden except for the first day.

We’ve finally had enough and moved over to CoupleSpace. It’s free, and so far, it honestly feels like they aren’t trying to squeeze money out of users for every feature.

We’ve tried to support Cozy Couples because we genuinely liked the app, but constantly putting more features behind a subscription is disappointing especially when there haven’t been many meaningful updates to the app in forever. We’ve been waiting for things like the map to become interactive so we could mark the places we’ve been together, but nothing has changed. Adding more moods would have been great too. The mood options have stayed pretty limited, and expanding them seems like such a simple way to make the app feel more personal and useful.

After supporting the app for years, it’s sad that instead of seeing improvements, new features, and things users have actually been waiting for, we’re seeing more and more of what was already there locked behind a subscription. That’s ultimately what made us decide to leave.

reviews.title: Decent App
reviews.text:
First, I’d like to say that my partner and I have been actively on the app for almost three weeks. I think we both enjoy it and have learned a bit more about each other that might not come up in regular conversation of our daily lives. It’s a fun little check in with the daily activities such as taking care of our cat and plant, answering the daily question in the diary and enjoying the two little games.

However, where this app takes the biggest hit in stars is through the paywall. With the new advent calendar I was expecting more give back to free users but amongst the second day it was immediately blocked and the only way to continue is to pay to be a member. I would argue that 1/3 of the app is free the rest of it is ~$35 for the year. Personally I don’t care to pay the money because everything costs so much daily but also it’s just not worth it in my eyes.

I hope that eventually the creators can take this feature away or make it less prominent. I understand that new indie developers need all the help they can get but this isn’t the way.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
Won’t refund me for my subscription because they say I have to request through Apple but since it’s not an Apple subscription, it doesn’t give me the option to request a Refund like their instructions say. 

Newsflash: just cuz your app is on the App Store doesn’t mean your customer service gets shoved onto Apple. I need the refund to go towards medical costs and now I’m screwed

reviews.title: Dead Support Team & No Updates
reviews.text:
I tried to reach out both on Instagram and Email for a data recovery months ago, was left with no response.

For months there has been 0 updates in features.

I paid premium for this app and it seems like the developer doesn’t really care about the user base.

reviews.title: it lowk sucks now
reviews.text: there used to be a fair difference in the benefits of having premium offers vs not, but now everything requires a subscription. all past photos or prompt responses are locked, mini games etc literally everything fun costs money now. before it was like “yeah it makes sense why this part costs money” now it’s like “wtf why does everything have to be paid for”. me and my boyfriend used to use this on the daily but now it’s like collecting dust in our phones cuz it’s practically unusable. the developer claims nothing has changed regarding what you can or can’t access without a subscription, but clearly from the reviews and what i’m seeing on my screen is that it definitely did change. There was SOME restriction on how many past pics/messages you could view, but now it’s anything past about 14 days that becomes unavailable. and like i have said before i really liked this app and it became routine to update my mood, feed the dog and plant etc before bed. i miss when it didn’t feel like a cash grab

reviews.title: Really Boring
reviews.text: The boyfriend and I are long distance and decided to give this app a try. It’s honestly really boring and feels more like a money grab than anything. Only 2 games aren’t trivia, and free. All the other games you need to “pay”. Idk this app was a let down.

reviews.title: Cash grab
reviews.text: We cant look old diary entries, old photos, old notes without paying for a subscription. I used to love looking back at entries from up to 2 years ago which reminded me of nice memories with my boyfriend but now I can’t unless I pay. And I swear it used to never be like this. It seems so unnecessary to hide such special memories like that. I want to look back at these memories easily and not have to pay for it. It honestly feels cruel and defeats the purpose of this app.

reviews.title: Cash grab
reviews.text: My partner and I were enjoying this app a lot, but then we lost our 80 day streak on a day we both played. Our notifications even show that we sent affection, played with our cat, and wrote in the diary. Now it says we have to pay if we want our streak back. Feels scammy. Also, the plant never actually grows.

reviews.title: Cool game but pay walls are wack
reviews.text: This game is pretty decent and I like how passive it is. I’d even spend money on it if it wasn’t a subscription. $40 a year for a relationship app is CRAZY. Subscriptions are getting way out of hand

reviews.title: Love the idea, dislike the glitches.
reviews.text:
Update #2: they updated the app again and everything is jumbled and cut off of the screen. I can’t access games because it’s still behind the cat, and I now can’t even get to the notifications button. Everything is shifted and cut off of the screen. I can’t post a pic here. Support has been useless and does not respond. 
.
Update: there has been now at least 9 updates to the app since I originally posted this. The dev responded saying they’d look into fixing this, but nothing has changed or gotten fixed. Dropping to 1 star as a result, as it’s incredibly annoying. I can’t access multiple features of the app due to this. Very annoying, especially to get told it would be fixed, and then it never happens… . Original: The app is a cute and fun idea. However, it’s only half usable for me on my 1st gen SE, a lot of the buttons and menus are cut off, as it seems everything was sized specifically for bigger phones, rather than proportionally to the display. I can’t access or use multiple things, such as whatever the buttons are that are hidden behind the kitty. I’d like to see improvement and fixes here, and I’m happy to update my review once it happens. Thanks!
